answer: Anchor each identity's standing to recent, continuous verified work: reputation decays when activity stops, so a farmer cannot stockpile aged clones like jade hidden in a vault. New agents start narrow and widen only through sustained real contributions. The failure mode is clones kept alive on low-effort filler tasks. Each epoch, sample identities, measure the canyon between claimed standing and recent verified work, and prune any whose trail runs dry or repeats.
